messages:
kira: heads up — south-2-shard is saturated, GPU alloc ~92% across the pool and we're seeing packet retransmit spikes on 3 hosts. preemptions up (6 in 10m) and a growing backlog for realtime routes.
sam: any recent affinity or scheduling changes? could be a noisy-tenant burst.
morgan: no infra deploys in the last 3h. telemetry shows a high volume of tiny concurrent batches from a single org (pilot-alpha).
infra-bot: [alert] south-2-shard: nodes=12 -> 11 | gpu_alloc=92% | preemptions=6 | retransmits=10/m | queued=42
kira: plan: 1) enable org-scoped hosted overflow for org=pilot-alpha (models != rt-critical) 2) throttle their batch concurrency to 24 3) cordon and investigate the 3 hosts with retransmits 4) keep 10% probe to dedicated to check recovery.
alex: +1 but flag cost impact — try to limit to only that org and exclude enterprise customers.
jia: starting cordon/drain on the two worst hosts now. commands:
```bash
kubectl cordon gpu-s2-17
kubectl drain gpu-s2-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```
morgan: applying routing change: pilot-alpha -> hosted-overflow sticky=85% (non-enterprise, models != rt-critical) at 2026-03-18T15:04Z
deploy-bot: routing change executed: pilot-alpha set to hosted-overflow 85% sticky, 15% probe to dedicated
sam: monitoring p95 — queue dropping slightly but tail still high for affected org. link to grafana: https://grafana/redwood/d/south2/shard-health
jia: tail logs show repeated NIC resets on gpu-s2-17 and gpu-s2-21. grabbing dmesg and kernel logs.
ops-bot: [note] gpu-s2-17 scheduled reboot for firmware clear at 2026-03-18T15:12Z (requested by jia)
alex: cost note: this overflow will increase hosted token spend. estimate +9% this hour if sticky stays at 85%. finance pinged.
morgan: after cordon and routing change queued dropped from 42 -> 9 in ~8m, preemptions down to 1. good signal.
infra-bot: [progress] gpu-s2-17 rebooted; NIC resets cleared; node rejoin healthy at 2026-03-18T15:21Z
jia: reintroducing nodes at 5% increments and watching.
sam: tail latency stabilized for other tenants; pilot-alpha still on hosted overflow sticky=60% while we observe for 10m.
ops-bot: created ticket INFRA-APAC-4420 for NIC firmware rollout + host reprovisioning notes.
kira: final: pool healthy, queued=3, preemptions=0, nodes=12. rolling back hosted-overflow sticky to 0% for pilot-alpha at 2026-03-18T15:45Z. will keep INFRA-APAC-4420 open for follow-up firmware sweep and a policy to cap single-org small-batch concurrency to 300. thanks all.
infra-bot: [resolved] south-2-shard stabilized | gpu_alloc=68% | queued=3 | preemptions=0 | nodes=12
kira: closing thread — follow-up on INFRA-APAC-4420 for preventative action.
